# Vendored files

- `dynamic-theme-fixes.config`: Dark Reader's per-site fixes for its dynamic theme, from
  https://github.com/darkreader/darkreader/blob/v4.9.133/src/config/dynamic-theme-fixes.config
  (MIT License, see ../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). `npm run update-fixes` replaces it with the
  latest version from Dark Reader's main branch; rebuild afterwards.
